title: Gary M NDE 6282
content: The first thing I remember was being helped from the back seat of the car by my friend Donnie. I immediately noticed that I could see the top of my own head and I could see Donnie helping me out of the car. He asked if I was all right and I remember feeling extremely ‘out of it.’ I said, ‘I think I hurt my arm.’ Donnie told me to lie down and he was going for the others. It was raining and when I laid back, I could feel the drops hitting my face. After about 2 seconds, I quite suddenly just shot right out of my body. I was traveling at a very high speed into complete darkness, like a universe with no stars. Suddenly I started seeing some stars in the distance. Then, again quite suddenly, (I'll call them ‘light beings’) two light beings flew directly in front of me and stopped me cold. I could feel that I still had this ‘thrust’ behind me, that if they moved I would move again. I remember quickly looking back, behind me and when I did, I saw a sort of umbilical cord of light going down to what appeared to be the world below. I gazed at the earth down there and it was spinning fast night/day/night/day like months were going by, and my light cord was attached to it. I turned back to the light beings and began to stare at them because it did not hurt to look at them, even though I thought it would make me squint. They had the appearance of hanging drapes sort of wavering a bit in a triangular shape with a pointed top and wide at the base. I remember saying ‘Let me go, I'd like to continue’ but it wasn't like my voice. It was as though it was telepathic somehow. The lights immediately responded in a very kind way ‘You're not going anywhere.’ It sounds a bit blunt, but it didn't at the time, it was sweet like a parent or a lover’s voice. I then stared directly at the lights and saw these long, dark red, really sharp and pointy crystals come out of the light and then pass into me. It was a little unsettling but it happened so fast and then the crystals went into me I felt the most amazing level of euphoria I have experienced in this life. I felt so incredibly strong and good it's just a failure to try to describe this in words. It was ecstasy; it was pure beauty. At that very moment, up there with the light beings feeling the experience, I suddenly heard my buddy Donnie like he was right in my ear saying ‘Don't leave me Gary! Wake up!’ And I did. I was back in my body, I felt all of the pain and it was raining on my face.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt extremely 'out of it' before suddenly 'shot right out of my body.'

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Traveling at very high speed into complete darkness, 'like a universe with no stars,' then seeing stars in the distance.

arrival.other_being_detail: Two 'light beings' appeared directly in front of him, stopped his motion, and communicated kindly.

environment.environment_other_detail: Darkness like a starless universe; later some stars; viewed Earth below spinning fast night/day cycles; 'umbilical cord of light' attached to Earth.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Umbilical cord/light cord connected to Earth; Earth seen spinning rapidly through night/day cycles; 'crystals' emerged from the light beings and passed into him producing euphoria.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE from body, rapid movement into dark void/space, encounter with two light beings who stop him, telepathic exchange and intense euphoric infusion, then abrupt return upon hearing friend.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Two light beings stopped his high-speed motion; he saw an 'umbilical cord of light' connected to Earth; long dark red sharp crystals came out of the light and passed into him, triggering intense euphoria; Earth appeared to spin rapidly night/day like months passing.

Wake up!”
